candidates.description: This feature vector represents biological cells and cellular processes.
This feature vector represents biological contamination, pathogens, and infectious agents.
This feature vector represents medical, biological, and clinical terminology, particularly relating to anatomy, treatment, and diagnostics.
This feature vector represents quantitative units of measurement and scale.
These tokens represent elided French articles and pronouns attached to subsequent words with an apostrophe.
This feature vector represents French auxiliary and linking verbs across various tenses and moods.
This feature vector represents medical or general problems, complications, and symptoms.
This vector represents word fragments and roots containing the letter sequence "oc" or similar phonetic and orthographic components common in French and English vocabulary.
These tokens represent French morphological suffixes, roots, and inflections related to the verb-forming and noun-forming "-ifier/-ication" family.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to demographic terms, particularly those relating to age groups, human populations, and social cohorts across multiple languages.
